entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The first and oldest of the Cosmos Monsters of Kaldheim, worshipped by elves.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: Overthrew the Einir gods and banished Koma from the realms.

entities.name: Einir gods
entities.description: Gods overthrown by the Skoti and imprisoned in Skemfar.

entities.name: Elves of Kaldheim
entities.description: Revere Koma and believe his banishment harms the World Tree.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Elf whose tattoos refer to Koma.

entities.name: Fynn
entities.description: Kannah leader and the only human to wound Koma; later killed the compleated Koma.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker who opened an Omenpath for Koma to enter Starnheim.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped repel Koma from Starnheim.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Tree linking the realms, destabilized by Koma's agitation.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Dangerous events increasing as the World Tree is destabilized.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Center of the Doomskar started by Tibalt.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: Used by Tibalt to open an Omenpath.

events.summary: The Skoti overthrew the Einir gods and prohibited Koma from entering any realm.
events.quote: when the Skoti overthrew the Einir gods , they also prohibited the Cosmos Serpent they revered from entering any of the realms.

events.summary: Fynn stabbed Koma, and the serpent's poisonous blood turned Fynn's blood to poison.
events.quote: it turned his blood to poison as well.

events.summary: Tibalt used the Sword of the Realms to open an Omenpath for Koma into Starnheim.
events.quote: the planeswalker Tibalt used the Sword of the Realms and opened an Omenpath for Koma to enter the realm

events.summary: The Valkyries, helped by Niko Aris, repelled Koma from Starnheim.
events.quote: The Serpent was repelled from Starnheim by the Valkyries with the help of the planeswalker Niko Aris .

events.summary: Koma closed the Omenpath connecting Bretagard and Karfell, destroying several draugr.
events.quote: Koma was responsible for closing the Omenpath that connected the realms of Bretagard and Karfell

events.summary: Koma was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion and killed by his rival Fynn.
events.quote: Koma was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion and killed by his rival Fynn .

relations.quote: Elves on Kaldheim share a reverence for Koma
when the Skoti overthrew the Einir gods
